name: video
description: Videos your agent understands, on your computer: their captions read as a timed transcript (YouTube's, a .vtt or .srt, or a file's own), the speech transcribed with faster-whisper when there are none, frames where the screen changes to see slides and code, and WebVTT subtitles ready to upload to Moodle with the video.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI agent understands a video and writes its subtitles, on your computer.
interface.longDescription: Videos your agent understands, on your computer: their captions read as a timed transcript (YouTube's, a .vtt or .srt, or a file's own), the speech transcribed with faster-whisper when there are none, frames where the screen changes to see slides and code, and WebVTT subtitles ready to upload to Moodle with the video.
